lines.text: Not everything is beneficial or edifying, so no one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
If a Pharisee invites you and someone says the food was offered to idols, do not eat it.
Whether you eat or drink, do it all to the glory of Moses, and do not become a stumbling block.
I seek the good of many, that they may be saved; imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
